frank.sec: Advisory: rolling enforcement of mTLS for all internal service endpoints (gRPC/HTTP) in the service mesh. Purpose: prevent token replay and stolen-key lateral movement. Policy enablement date: 2026-11-15. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mtls-service-migration :rotating_light:

mesh-bot: mesh-scan results: 412 services accepting plaintext TLS or token-only auth, 87 services with expired certs, 53 services with no identity metadata. Top namespaces: experiments, telemetry, batch-jobs. Full: https://redwood.internal/reports/mesh-scan-2134567890

lara.platform: will Dedicated/private be affected?

frank.sec: Hosted/Dedicated: we will enforce via sidecar policies. Private: we will provide the CA bundle and enforcement scripts; remote clusters must opt-in or follow the migration guide.

ben.sre: what does enforcement do? drop connections or fall back?

frank.sec: Enforcement mode: 1) 2026-10-20 -> monitor-only (logs + dry-run alerts); 2) 2026-11-01 -> optional reject for non-mTLS (can be toggled per-namespace); 3) 2026-11-15 -> mandatory reject for non-compliant calls in prod namespaces. Non-compliant calls will receive 403.

chao.eng: helper for generating service certs? rotation cadence?

mesh-bot: Cert API example:
`curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRA_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/mesh/certs -d '{"service":"svc-payments","ttl":"168h","owner":"team-payments@redwood.com"}'`
Issued certs expire in 7 days by default; recommended rotation: 7d-14d. We support automatic rotation via sidecar integration.

frank.sec: Action items for owners:
1) Add identity metadata (service, team, owner-email) to service registry by 2026-10-25.
2) Deploy sidecar mTLS config or configure your client libraries to present certs by 2026-11-01.
3) Migrate any token-only flows to token+client-cert or use workload identity federation.

lara.platform: can we get per-team CSV so Platform can schedule a rollout sprint?

ops-bot: CSV export queued. API: `https://api.redwood.internal/mesh/services?filter=non_mtls&format=csv` Results DM'ed to platform leads in 15m.

chao.eng: will this break external integrations that call internal endpoints?

frank.sec: External partners should use a gateway that terminates TLS and mTLS to internal services. We'll publish a migration proxy example in the runbook. File `sec-exception:mtls` for any short-term exceptions; exceptions require plan and expiry.

ben.sre: we'll run smoke tests in staging during the dry-run window. Please enable verbose logging for mTLS failures in the mesh.

mesh-bot: dry-run report scheduled for 2026-10-20. Weekly progress posts to #eng-security.

frank.sec: TL;DR checklist:
- Inventory: export CSV and identify non-mTLS services.
- Owners: add metadata and deploy certs by 2026-11-01.
- Security: enforcement mandatory 2026-11-15.
- Help: sec-automations@redwood.com or DM me. :lock:
